title: 第19章 夺取宝物第20章 堵住洞府
content_zh:
楚峰顿时惊醒了过来。
是啊！
让葫灵隐身，他自己岂不是轻松多了。
“那就麻烦前辈了。”
楚峰心中狂喜。
楚峰将所有的灵石都一股脑儿的给了葫灵。
“爽，真是爽！
好久没有这样大吃一顿了。”
葫灵的大笑声在楚峰的脑海中响起。
“葫灵前辈，我们是不是可以走了？”
楚峰尝试着问道。
“走，当然要走，本灵可是感应到里面还有一块碎片呢！
赶紧进去，把那块碎片拿到手！”
随后，在葫灵的帮助下，两人再也没有遇到阵法的阻拦，很快便到达了洞府的最深处。
两人放慢了脚步。
“小子，那是最后一座大殿了，他们应该进入了里面。
待会儿我们进去后，你可不要再出什么篓子啊！”
庞烈提醒道。
他们前方不远处，有着一座恢弘的大殿。
与之前的大殿不同，这座大殿保存的非常完好。

只不过保护大殿的阵法已经被三大宗门的长老给硬生生的攻破了。
“老庞，放心吧！”
楚峰肯定的说道。
有葫灵前辈在，怎么会出问题。
铛铛铛。
两人刚进入大殿，就听到了一阵打斗声。
两人小心翼翼的朝着大殿深处摸了过去。
大能洞府最深处的大殿内，有着九道光团。
每一个光团之中都有着一个宝物。
不过，因为光团笼罩的缘故，让人无法看清光团之中是何物。
而在光团前面，三大宗门的六位长老，此刻正在和六具傀儡战斗。
值得一提的是，玄阴教又重新派来了一位长老。
而在两边，还有着三具傀儡未曾被激活。
一旦有人靠近那些光团，必然会惊动这三具傀儡。
“麻烦了，没想到这里竟然会有傀儡守护！”
庞烈背着楚峰，站在门口角落里。
“小子，你的隐身能力能不能潜入到那九个光团那里去？”
庞烈问道。
“这个，应该可以吧！”
楚峰不确定的回应道，同时心中问道。

“前辈，能不能做到啊？”
在这里，只能看葫灵了。
“能做到，不过不能带着他！
否则，我们刚一靠近，就会被那三具傀儡感应到。
content_en:
Chu Feng suddenly woke up.
yes!
Wouldn't it be much easier for him to make Hu Ling invisible?
"Then I'll trouble you, senior."
Chu Feng was ecstatic.
Chu Feng gave all the spirit stones to Hu Ling.
“It’s cool, it’s really cool!
It’s been a long time since I had such a big meal. "
Hu Ling's laughter sounded in Chu Feng's mind.
"Senior Hu Ling, can we leave?"
Chu Feng tried to ask.
"Let's go, of course we have to go, but I sensed that there is still a fragment inside!
Hurry in and get that piece! "
Later, with the help of Hu Ling, the two of them no longer encountered the obstruction of the formation, and soon reached the deepest part of the cave.
The two slowed down.
“Boy, that’s the last hall, they should have entered it.
When we go in later, don't make any more mistakes! "
Pang Lie reminded.
Not far ahead of them, there was a magnificent hall.
Unlike the previous hall, this hall is very well preserved.
It's just that the formation protecting the main hall has been forcefully broken through by the elders of the three major sects.
"Lao Pang, don't worry!"
Chu Feng said affirmatively.
With Senior Hu Ling here, how could anything go wrong?
Clang clang clang.
As soon as the two entered the hall, they heard a fight.
The two of them cautiously moved towards the depths of the hall.
In the deepest hall of the Great Neng Cave, there are nine light groups.
There is a treasure in every light group.
However, because of the shroud of light, it is impossible to see clearly what is in the light group.
In front of the light group, six elders from the three major sects were fighting six puppets at the moment.
It is worth mentioning that the Xuanyin Sect has sent another elder.
On both sides, there are still three puppets that have not been activated.
Once someone approaches those light groups, these three puppets will inevitably be alarmed.
"Trouble, I didn't expect there would be puppets guarding here!"
Pang Lie stood in the corner of the door with Chu Feng on his back.
"Boy, can your invisibility allow you to sneak into those nine light groups?"
Pang Lie asked.
"This should be fine!"
Chu Feng responded uncertainly and asked in his mind.
"Senior, can you do it?"
Here, you can only see the gourd spirit.
“I can do it, but I can’t take him with me!
Otherwise, as soon as we get close, we will be sensed by the three puppets.
